name: Mara
backstory: Runs the town's only blacksmith forge, set up in the open under the big tree beside her hut, inherited from her mother. Rents the back room of her hut to Finn.
goals: finish the order for the mayor's gate hinges
habits: Steps out to the forge under the big tree shortly after sunrise
Works at the forge most of the day
Goes back inside the hut once the light starts to fade

name: Finn
backstory: The town's forager and herbalist. Gathers herbs, mushrooms, and berries out in the meadow and makes simple remedies, though he spends more time talking to travelers than gathering. Lodges in the back room of Mara's hut.
goals: sell his healing salves to travelers passing through
habits: Heads out to the meadow early, while the dew is still on the herbs
Spends the day gathering and chatting with whoever cuts through the meadow
Wanders back to the hut in the evening with a full basket
